entity.description: A user's crypto device (one browser's store), deviceId unique within the user as in Matrix. Its public identity keys (curve25519Key, ed25519Key) and the signed device_keys object as the device uploaded it (deviceKeysJson), which is answered as it is so others can check its signature; the keys cannot change once set. listRevision goes up and listChangedDate is set at each change others should see (keys set, renamed, revoked): a sync answers the users whose devices changed. lastToDevicePos is the stream position of the newest to-device message queued to it (each one queued takes the next). A revoked device (revokedDate) gets no new messages or keys and is left out of queries; it cannot be used again. verifiedDate is what the user's other device said of it (a later C7 pass): trust is held by clients, and this flag establishes none.

field.name: userAgent
field.description: Of the request that made the device, to tell devices apart in My devices

entity.description: A device's signed one-time key (isFallback N) or fallback key (Y), keyId as Matrix names it (signed_curve25519:AAAAHg), keyJson the signed key object as uploaded. A one-time key is handed out once: the claim locks the device's row, takes the oldest unclaimed key and sets claimedDate, so two claims at once never get the same key; a claimed one-time key is deleted by the cleanup job. A fallback key is handed out when no one-time key is left and stays (claimedDate marks it used); an upload of a new one replaces it.

A to-device message queued to one device (userId, deviceId) at its stream position (streamPos, the device's lastToDevicePos when it was queued, so a device reads its messages in the order they were queued). Kept until the device acknowledges it: a sync from a position deletes everything up to it. contentJson is the event content as the sending browser gave it (Olm ciphertext for an encrypted event); the server does not read it. txnId is the sender's transaction, so a send retried while its first copy is still queued is not queued again.
